'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Casualties of the Gaza war]], [[Gaza genocide]]
***A mass funeral is held for 112 bodies that were recovered from a Israeli strike in the [[Sabra, Gaza City|Sabra]] neighborhood of [[Gaza City]] during the early weeks of the war. [https://www.haaretz.com/gaza/2026-08-04/ty-article/.premium/mass-funeral-held-in-gaza-for-112-people-recovered-from-2023-strike-rubble/0000019f-cc03-db33-a5ff-fe77b7df0000 (Haaretz)]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] reaffirms that [[Israel]] will not withdraw from the [[Gaza Strip]] until [[Hamas]] disarms. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/netanyahu-says-israel-will-not-withdraw-from-gaza-until-hamas-is-completely-disarmed (PBS)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Rapid Support Forces]] senior commander and [[Brigadier general|Brigadier General]] [[Mahdi Adam Ismail]], also known as ''Jebel Moon'', is confirmed to be killed during clashes with the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and the [[Darfur Joint Protection Force|Joint Forces]] in [[West Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. His death is confirmed by [[Sudan Liberation Movement/Army|Sudan Liberation Movement]] leader and [[Darfur Regional Government|Governor of Darfur]] [[Minni Minnawi|Minni Arko Minnawi]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article/317039 (''Sudan Tribune'')] [https://sudannabaa.com/en/news-en/killing-of-militia-commander-mahdi-adam-ismail-known-as-jabal-moon/88013/?amp=1 (Sudan Nabaa)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[President of Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz President]] [[Sadyr Japarov]] signs a law banning the use of [[cremation]] for deceased human bodies in [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://akipress.com/news:910655:Kyrgyzstan_bans_cremation_of_human_bodies/?place=main1 (AKIPress)] [https://en.kabar.kg/news/kyrgyzstan-officially-bans-cremation/ (Kabar)]
*[[South Sudan]]'s [[South Sudan Police Service|National Police Service]] arrests 60 suspected gang members in a series of operations targeting criminal gangs, [[Illegal drug trade|drug trafficking]], and youth delinquency in its [[capital city|capital]] [[Juba]]. [https://www.sudanspost.com/south-sudan-police-arrest-60-in-anti-gang-operation-in-juba/ (''Sudans Post'')]
*Four people are killed and four others are injured in a [[shooting spree]] by a [[Desertion|rogue]] Russian soldier in [[Sevastopol]], [[Russian occupation of Crimea|Russian occupied Crimea]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/serviceman-shoots-civilians-soldiers-crimea-deaths/ (CBS News)]

'''Sports'''
*In [[basketball]], the [[Women's National Basketball Association]] (WNBA) announces that the expansion team in [[Cleveland]], [[Ohio]], [[U.S.]], will be called the [[Cleveland Sirens|Sirens]]. The organization will debut in [[2028 WNBA season|2028]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7490965/2026/08/04/cleveland-sirens-wnba-expansion-2028/ (''The Athletic'' via ''The New York Times'')]
